description_en: Queries the list of access addresses for a directional group
description_zh: 查询定向分组的访问地址列表
name: ListDirectionalAddress

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10, 15, 25, and 40
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Use this parameter together with the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询页数，需结合PageSize参数使用
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The directional group ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html operation to obtain the directional group ID (DirectionalGroupId) from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
定向分组ID。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/374328.html在返回参数中查看定向分组ID（DirectionalGroupId）
parameters.name: group_id
